description:
The upper plot illustrates the evolution of the variable n over m in a streaming setting. The x-axis is labeled "m" and uses a continuous linear scale starting from an origin of 0, extending to the right with a directional arrow, and featuring a specific tick mark labeled "m_0" without specified units. The y-axis is labeled "n" at the tip of its directional arrow, using a linear scale from an origin of 0, with specific variable tick labels at "w", "c - a - s", and "c - a", each aligned with horizontal dashed lines extending into the graph space. A solid black line with no markers displays a repeating sawtooth pattern across the plot. It begins at y = 0 slightly to the right of the x-axis origin, rises linearly to a peak at y = c - a, and drops vertically down to y = w. This pattern of rising to c - a and dropping to w repeats multiple times, followed by a horizontal dotted ellipsis indicating a break or continuation in the sequence. After the ellipsis, the sawtooth pattern resumes; at the exact x-axis position of m_0, the line reaches a peak that aligns perfectly with the dashed line for y = c - a - s before dropping vertically. Following m_0, the line continues its sawtooth pattern, but each subsequent peak reaches a visibly lower y-value until the line terminates.
